label: For "Acquisition Deal Sourcing": Find off-market properties likely to sell by combining ownership, debt maturity, lease expiry and behaviour signals. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Observed sales are biased towards properties that were listed, so off-market sales are missed.
